stories.title: Papstbesuch in Frankreich: «Die älteste Tochter der Kirche» empfängt Leo XIV. – und Präsident Macron schmollt

en.title: Papal visit to France: 'The eldest daughter of the Church' receives Leo XIV – and President Macron sulks
en.summary: A pope visits Paris for the first time in eighteen years on an apostolic mission. The visit occurs as France has become more secular and religiously diverse, with President Macron playing an unexpectedly minor role.

stories.title: A l'ONU, Benjamin Netanyahu pourfend les détracteurs d'Israël

en.title: At the UN, Benjamin Netanyahu attacks Israel's detractors
en.summary: Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu delivered a strong critique against Israel's critics at the United Nations while campaigning for reelection, coinciding with increased violence against Palestinians in occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Wolfsbarsch und chinesischer Weisskohl: Auch beim Staatsbankett versucht Trump, Xis Geschmack zu treffen

en.title: Sea bass and Chinese cabbage: Trump tries to match Xi's taste at the state banquet too
en.summary: A formal reception at the White House featured numerous American CEOs from industry and finance. Chinese business leaders were initially absent from the event.

stories.title: Time Journey 2026: comment six maisons horlogères ouvrent leurs savoir-faire au public

en.title: Time Journey 2026: how six watchmaking houses open their expertise to the public
en.summary: Time Journey has expanded from two to three days to help the public understand watchmaking alongside appreciating it. The second edition emphasizes transmission, dialogue, and experiences tailored to each watchmaking house.

stories.title: Aktion «Keine 50-Grad-Sommer» – Die Klimabewegung nimmt einen neuen Anlauf

en.title: Action "No 50-Degree Summers" – Climate Movement Launches New Initiative
en.summary: Climate activists are relaunching their movement with demonstrations across Swiss cities, with plans extending through the election year 2027.

stories.title: Aus für Eigenmietwert – Neue Bündner Steuer auf Zweitwohnungen soll Finanzloch stopfen

en.title: End of Imputed Rent Tax – New Graubünden Tax on Second Homes to Close Budget Gap
en.summary: Graubünden plans to introduce a tax on second homes to offset millions in lost revenue, potentially establishing itself as a pioneer in this approach.

stories.title: Treffen im Weissen Haus – Trump empfängt Xi zum prunkvollen Staatsbankett

en.title: White House Meeting – Trump Hosts Xi for Grand State Banquet
en.summary: A meeting between the two leaders at the White House produces no breakthroughs, with discussions on Taiwan, artificial intelligence, and Iran revealing significant differences.

stories.title: Spaniens Rechte auf Konfrontationskurs mit Marokko: Selbst die Fussball-WM wird jetzt infrage gestellt

en.title: Spain's Right-Wing Parties on Confrontational Course with Morocco: Even Football World Cup Now in Question
en.summary: Spanish right-wing parties PP and Vox are capitalizing on public anger over the Ceuta crisis, launching strong attacks on Morocco while drawing on historical anti-Arab sentiments.

stories.title: Un incendie se déclare dans une usine de matériaux isolants à Lucens

en.title: Fire breaks out at insulation materials factory in Lucens
en.summary: A fire occurred overnight at an insulation materials manufacturing facility in Lucens, Vaud. The canton alerted the population through the Alertswiss platform.

stories.title: Un incendie s’est déclaré dans une usine à Lucens

en.title: Fire breaks out at factory in Lucens
en.summary: A fire started at an insulation materials manufacturing facility in Lucens, Vaud, producing heavy smoke and disrupting traffic. Alertswiss advised residents in the area to seal their homes.

stories.title: Starbucks, en restructuration, annonce fermer de nouveaux cafés en Amérique du Nord

en.title: Starbucks, undergoing restructuring, announces closure of new cafés in North America
en.summary: Starbucks announced the closure of approximately 250 locations in North America by week's end, representing about 1% of its 18,000+ cafés in the region. The chain is implementing these closures as part of a broader restructuring following years of financial difficulties.

stories.title: Starbucks continue de boire la tasse et ferme 250 cafés en Amérique du Nord

en.title: Starbucks continues to struggle and closes 250 cafés in North America
en.summary: Starbucks announced the closure of 250 underperforming cafés in North America as part of its strategic restructuring following years of financial challenges.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Deutscher Politiker fordert harte China-Zölle: «Wir verfüttern den Mittelstand und hoffen, dass wenige Grossunternehmen als Letztes gefressen werden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - German politician calls for tough China tariffs: "We're feeding the middle class to the wolves and hoping a few large corporations are the last to be eaten"
en.summary: A rising CDU talent argues that Europe must adopt protectionist trade policies against Chinese overcapacity to prevent continental deindustrialization.

stories.title: Die EU geht gegen grünen Etikettenschwindel vor – und sorgt auch bei Schweizer Textilfirmen für grosse Verunsicherung

en.title: The EU cracks down on green marketing deception – causing major uncertainty among Swiss textile firms
en.summary: The EU will ban misleading environmental claims in clothing marketing starting late September, creating concerns that stricter rules might paradoxically reduce overall sustainability efforts.

stories.title: «Europa ist die Nummer vier» – die USA holen die Nato-Partner auf den Boden der Realität

en.title: "Europe is number four" – the USA brings NATO allies back to reality
en.summary: The American NATO ambassador emphasizes Europe's diminished global significance, while research suggests Europeans cannot defend themselves without US support before 2030.

stories.title: Rivalität zwischen China und den USA: Der Welthandel ist stärker regionalisiert als es sein Name impliziert

en.title: Rivalry between China and the USA: global trade is more regionally concentrated than its name suggests
en.summary: Trump's trade war accelerated geographic concentration in global commerce, with the USA and Switzerland standing out as notable exceptions to this regionalization trend.

stories.title: Vor dreissig Jahren eroberten die Taliban erstmals Kabul: Die Parallelen zur Gegenwart sind verblüffend

en.title: Thirty Years Ago the Taliban First Conquered Kabul: The Parallels to the Present are Striking
en.summary: The Taliban entered Kabul for the first time on September 26, 1996. Their discriminatory policies toward women made their regime internationally isolated then, similar to conditions today.
